summary: NextDecade Corp filed an 8-K reporting its indirect subsidiary Rio Grande LNG Intermediate HoldCo Borrower entered into a $1.0 billion term loan credit agreement. The proceeds will be used primarily for an equity contribution to RGLNG to reduce outstanding borrowings under its credit facilities, plus fees and general expenses. The loan matures June 17, 2033, bears 7.05% interest payable semi-annually in-kind for three years then optionally cash, with prepayment call protection until 2029. This is a routine financing transaction without control change, tender, or restructuring elements; thus it does not constitute a special situation.
